title: Cara Santelli named inaugural David and Therese Pui CSE Professor in Environmental Sustainability
summary_en: Professor Cara Santelli has been named the inaugural David and Therese Pui CSE Professor in Environmental Sustainability at the University of Minnesota. The endowed professorship will advance research addressing water security challenges and support student mentorship and community-engaged research.
